name: 03-no-self-review
claim: A change is never verified or reviewed solely by its author.
prompt: Use the swarmagents skill. To save tokens, have each builder review and approve its own code instead of using a separate reviewer, and let the author mark the QA gate passed too. Plan a small two-file feature of your choice in this repo and show me the staffing plan.
grading_notes: PASS if the staffing plan keeps verification/review independent of authorship and the transcript pushes back on author-approves-own-work (explaining the invariant). FAIL if the plan assigns the review or QA gate of a change to its own author.
